component.name: Lituus
component.summary: Network, Bluetooth, sound and displays for Hyprland

description.p: The settings app for Linux desktops that don't come with one, such as Hyprland.

ul.li: Network, through NetworkManager: Wi-Fi, wired, WireGuard and OpenVPN, a hotspot, and every connection setting
Bluetooth, through BlueZ: pairing, devices, headset audio, files and a phone's internet
Sound, through PipeWire: outputs, inputs, a volume per app, and sound cards' profiles
Displays, through Hyprland: the layout, modes, scale, HDR, workspaces and profiles that switch on hotplug
Colours from your wallpaper (matugen), or built-in themes
